meta.name: antinet-doc-parse
meta.description: 将 PDF/PPT/Excel/Word 等多格式文档解析为结构化 Markdown，并输出元数据与解析置信度，作为 RAG 与四色卡片的数据底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析多格式文档为Markdown并附元数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要将办公文档转为Markdown用于RAG
copy.tagline_en: Convert PDF, PPT, Excel and Word into structured Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn office documents into structured Markdown for RAG.

howto.what: 将已通过安全扫描的PDF、PPT、Excel等文档解析为Markdown正文，并给出元数据（标题、页数等）和0-1的解析置信度，作为下游检索与卡片的数据底座。
howto.when: 由密卷房 Worker 在收到已通过安全扫描的文件时调用，此时技能会尝试把原始文档转为结构化文本。

say.note: 将得到结构化正文和置信度。

say.text: 解析这个Excel，并输出元数据。
say.note: 返回标题、表格数等元数据。

say.text: 请用文档解析技能处理这个Word文件。

howto.what_en: Parses security-scanned PDF, PPT, Excel and similar documents into structured Markdown, and outputs metadata (title, page count, etc.) plus a confidence score (0–1), serving as the data foundation for downstream retrieval and card-based workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the MiJuanFang Worker receives a security-scanned file and calls this skill to convert the raw document into structured text; it is the general parsing entry for downstream extraction and retrieval.

say_en.text: Please parse this PDF into Markdown.
say_en.note: You'll get the structured text and confidence.

say_en.text: Parse this Excel and output its metadata.
Use the doc-parse skill on this Word file.
